ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets; HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company; and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 is only a successors-and-assigns sentence, so HDI could assign to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without our consent. We have added one sentence keeping our freedom to assign to an affiliate or M&A successor, gating HDI assignments on our consent (not unreasonably withheld) with a competitor bar, and confirming our change of control gives HDI no termination right.
input.summary: Insert assignment consent standard: Company free to assign to affiliates/M&A successors; HDI needs our consent, no competitor assignment, no HDI termination on our change of control.
